content.text:
Done! Created `src/render.js` with `renderInvoiceText(invoice)` that renders invoices as plain text:
- First line: invoice number or "DRAFT"
- Customer ID line
- One line per invoice line: qty, product name, unit price (via `formatEuros()`), line total (via `formatEuros()`)
- Final line: "Total: " + total amount (via `formatEuros()`)

All amounts shown to customers go through `formatEuros()` as required. Added 11 comprehensive tests covering draft/issued invoices, single/multiple lines, small/high values, line ordering, and output structure. All 72 tests pass ✓
